headlines.title: Visa (V) Hands Over 6 Million Documents As DOJ Debit Card Case Drags On
headlines.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has delivered 6 million documents to the US Department of Justice as part of an ongoing government debit card lawsuit. The discovery phase in the case has been extended until 2027, with a trial currently expected in 2028. The scale and duration of the proceedings highlight continued regulatory scrutiny of Visa's debit card practices. headlines.title: Wildfire Appoints Mike Grillo as Senior Vice President of Data and Consumer Insights
headlines.summary: Wildfire Systems, a loyalty and consumer insights platform, today announced the appointment of Mike Grillo as senior vice president of data and consumer insights, a strategic hire that will help Wildfire unlock greater value from consumer insights derived from the company's platform. Working across Wildfire's product, merchant and client teams, he will focus on helping partners better understand their customers, optimize their programs and develop new products and services.

headlines.title: Visa Launches Enhanced A2A Protect Innovations to Help Financial Institutions Stop Fraud Before Money Leaves Accounts
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, September 01, 2026--Visa (NYSE: V), a world leader in digital payments, today announced an enhanced version of A2A Protect, delivering real-time risk insights that help banks stop account-to-account fraud before money leaves customer accounts. The expanded solution introduces a new unified fraud score—Visa’s first in-market integration of Featurespace technology—giving financial institutions faster, clearer signals to detect more fraud while reducing unnecessary alerts.

headlines.title: Chesapeake Bank Announces Casey Porter as Incoming President for Chesapeake Payment Systems
headlines.summary: KILMARNOCK, VA / ACCESS Newswire / August 31, 2026 / Chesapeake Bank announces that Casey Porter has joined Chesapeake Payment Systems (CPS) as President and will succeed Kate Root, who plans to retire at the end of 2026 after a distinguished career leading the division.

description: Visa Inc. operates as a payment technology company in the United States and internationally. The company operates VisaNet, a transaction processing network that enables authorization, clearing, and settlement of payment transactions. It also offers credit, debit, and prepaid card products; tap to pay, tokenization, and click to pay services; Visa Direct, a platform which facilitates money movement, enabling clients to collect, hold, convert, and send funds across its network; and issuing solutions, such as airport lounge access, dining reservations, shopping experiences, event tickets, and seller offers. In addition, the company provides acceptance solutions, an omnichannel payment integration with e-commerce platforms; risk detection and prevention solutions; and advisory and other services comprising consulting practice, proprietary analytics models, data scientists and economists, marketing services, and managed services. It provides its services under the Visa, Visa Electron, V PAY, Interlink, and PLUS brands. The company serves consumers, sellers, financial institutions, and government entities. Visa Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
